spans.s:
लीवत्पितृक m. (-कः) A son whose father is alive.
 E. जीवत्, and पितृ a
a father, कप् added.

लिवि f. (-विः-वी) Writing, hand-writing, or a writing, a manuscript. E.
लिप् to smear, (with ink,) Unādi aff. इक्, with the vowel unchan-
ged, and व substituted for प ।

लिविकर m. (-रः) A scribe, a writer.
 E. लिवि writing, कर who executes.

लिविङ्कर m. (-रः) A writer, a scribe.
 E. लिवि writing, कृ to practise, खच् aff.
